cwe_content.cwe: CWE-89,Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

candidate.Reason: Direct string concatenation of user-controlled input (programUid) into SQL query without proper sanitization, making it vulnerable to SQL injection if the input contains malicious SQL code.

candidate.Code:
return Stream.concat(

            userOrgUnitPaths.stream()
